settings.heading: The Philosophy of Living Botanicals
settings.text_paragraph_1: At Aryvan, botanical wellness is not merely an extraction; it is a sacred dialogue with the earth. We honor the innate intelligence of whole plants, cultivating harmony between ancestral herbalism and contemporary botanical science.
settings.text_paragraph_2: Every tincture, elixir, and balm is slow-steeped in small artisanal vessels, ensuring the living phytochemical matrix remains uncompromised and fully resonant.
settings.quote: Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.

settings.title: Cold-Pressed & Infused

settings.title: Whole-Plant Integrity

settings.title: Harmonic Adaptogens

settings.title: Zero Synthetic Additives

settings.heading: Botanical Ingredients & Natural Principles
settings.text: We formulate exclusively with whole-plant botanicals, cold infusions, and biodynamic extracts to respect the living essence of nature.

settings.title: 100% Plant-Derived
settings.text: Every ingredient originates directly from earth-grown botanicals, unadulterated by synthetic additives.

settings.title: Conscious & Cruelty-Free

settings.title: Amber Glass Packaging
settings.text: Bottled in UV-protective recyclable amber glass to shield fragile botanical compounds from photo-oxidation.

settings.title: Artisanal Small Batches
